text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It's... finally here, the Make Debut. 
I'm nervous, but... Still, but, but~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I had a realization! Going to watch the 
Derby with the three of us made me realize 
I can't go on like this!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I have to change. Ever since my Make 
Debut, I knew I had to become a different 
me. That's why, that's whyyyy, ababababa!"
choice_data_list: You're slurring your words, you know?
You're tripping over your words a little?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fweh? I'm sorry~. My heart just started 
beating so fast...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I will show you a splendid run, so 
please watch over me, Trainer, Opera 
O-san."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mhm, I like your spirit. Go get 'em, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A response that was impossible to tell 
whether it was an answer or a strange 
screech. Still—let us place our hopes in 
it!
